item.title: Eating at Home in Seoul — A Summer of Homesul and Homebap
item.description: A summer of eating at home in Seoul: Kahlúa milk with spicy jjukkumi, delivered sora-muchim stretched with hand-boiled somyeon, Deungchon shabu-shabu broth with supermarket beef, samgyeopsal buried in minari, and yukhoe with homemade malatang. Including what worked and what did not.
